subject: Game startup admission waits for mission content readiness
defect: Before the change, Game.Server.Start called SetupCommunicator and accepted world clients before MissionContentManager.Load. In isolated replay courtyard-cover-feedback-21, RequestSwitchToCharacterInSlot occurred at 18:54:14.818 but content rules loaded at 18:54:17.561. No private instance was created, and the copied client reached a boot camp map without its placed companions or hostile Thrax. This was a server startup race, not a creature aggro finding.
implementation: src/Rasa.Game/Game/Server.cs now starts accepting world clients and connects/advertises to Auth only after all startup managers, including MissionContentManager, finish loading. The listener remains bound during loading but has no pending AcceptAsync and Auth has no connected game server to redirect to it.
